x-jarvis-example:
Method: DRAM
Bounds:
  num_chains: 4
  num_iters: 2000
  proposal_scale: 0.2
  adapt_enabled: true
  dr_steps: 2
  dr_scale_factors: [1.0, 0.5]
  seed: 0
Variables:
  - name: x
    distribution:
      type: Flat
      parameters: {min: 0.0, max: 1.0}

Bounds.description: DRAM settings. proposal_scale may be per-chain. Prefer num_chains >= Runtime workers.

num_chains.description: Number of independent chains (async 1-inflight each; prefer >= workers).

num_iters.description: Number of Metropolis transitions per chain (each transition may use delayed-rejection stages).

proposal_scale.description: Initial proposal scale; a scalar or one-element list broadcasts, while a full list maps one scale to each chain.

adapt_start_iter.description: First iteration at which covariance adaptation may start (default 100).

adapt_window.description: Rolling window length for the empirical covariance (default 25).

adapt_eps.description: Diagonal ridge added to the adapted covariance (default 1e-6).

adapt_scale.description: Overall scale of the adapted Gaussian proposal (default 2.38).

dr_steps.description: Number of delayed-rejection stages per iteration, including the first proposal (default 2).

dr_scale_factors.description: Positive scale factor for each delayed-rejection stage (default [1.0, 0.5]).

on_failure.description: Failed-sample policy: reject the Metropolis proposal or halt the scan (default reject).
